require "gmcphelper" require 'tprint'
commlog_id = "b555825a4a5700c35fa80780"
------------------------- Helper Functions ------------------------
function exists(x) return x and x ~= "" end -- exists --
function is_empty(xs) return xs and next(xs) == nil end -- is_empty --
function table.i_copy(xs) local ys = {}
if xs then for k, v in pairs(xs) do table.insert(ys, v) end end
return ys end -- table.i_copy --
function is_self(name) if string.lower(name) == "you" then return self_name else return name end end -- is_self --
function help() print("Activity Tracker help") print("------------------------------------------------------------------------------") print("acti help") print("acti report -> report tracked data") print("acti reset -> reset data") print("acti remove <member> -> remove member from data, if they have left the group (case sensitive)") print("acti next/prev -> scroll through window data options (or use right-click menu)") print("------------------------------------------------------------------------------") print("acti loop new -> begin recording a new loop, ends and saves one if in progress") print("acti loop end -> ends recording and saves the current loop without starting a new one") print("acti loop discard -> ends recording and discards the current loop") print("acti loop reset -> ends recording and deletes all loop data") print("acti loop report -> reports total saved loop performance to this point") print("------------------------------------------------------------------------------") print("acti test <on/off> -> toggle displaying test messages (very spammy)") end -- help --
function set_test_mode(name, line, args) test_mode = args.cmd == "on" print("ACTI test mode is now " .. args.cmd) end -- set_test_mode --
function test_print(text) if test_mode then print(text) end end -- test_print --
------------------------- End Helper Functions ------------------------
------------------------------- Classes -------------------------------
local Player = {} Player.__index = Player function Player:new(name, qs) local player = setmetatable({}, Player)
player.name = name player.casts = {} player.total_casts = 0 player.attacks = {} player.total_attacks = 0 player.healing = {} player.total_healing = 0 player.quaffs = 0 player.rescues = 0 player.deaths = 0 player.quests = 0 player.qs = qs -- quest status see https://www.aardwolf.com/wiki/index.php/Clients/GMCP
return player end -- Player --
function Player:attack(atk) if self.attacks[atk.target] == nil then self.attacks[atk.target] = 1 else self.attacks[atk.target] = self.attacks[atk.target] + 1 end self.total_attacks = self.total_attacks + 1 end -- Player.attack --
function Player:cast(spell) if self.casts[spell] == nil then self.casts[spell] = 1 else self.casts[spell] = self.casts[spell] + 1 end self.total_casts = self.total_casts + 1 end -- Player:cast --
function Player:quaff(potion) self.quaffs = self.quaffs + 1 end -- Player.quaff --
function Player:quest() self.quests = self.quests + 1 end -- Player.quest --
function Player:rescue(player) self.rescues = self.rescues + 1 end -- Player.rescue --
function Player:die(killer) self.deaths = self.deaths + 1 end -- Player.die --
function Player:to_string() local output = self.name output = output .. " -> Atk: " .. self.total_attacks output = output .. " | Heal: <N/A> " output = output .. " | Cast: " .. self.total_casts output = output .. " | Resc: " .. self.rescues output = output .. " | Pot: " .. self.quaffs output = output .. " | D: " .. self.deaths output = output .. " | Q: " .. self.quests return(output) end
local Attack = {} Attack.__index = Attack function Attack:new(attacker, attack, target, crit, hits, damage) local atk = setmetatable({}, Attack)
atk.attacker = attacker atk.target = target atk.attack = attack atk.crit = crit atk.hits = hits atk.damage = damage
return atk end -- Attack --
----------------------------- End Classes -------------------------------
----------------------------- Trigger Captures --------------------------
function attack_capture(name, line, args) local attacker = is_self(args.attacker) local target = is_self(args.target) args.pretitle = args.pretitle or "" local atk = Attack:new(attacker, args.attack, target, args.crit, args.hits, args.damage)
if players[attacker] ~= nil then players[attacker]:attack(atk) end
if is_looping(attacker) then current_loop[attacker]:attack(atk) end
test_print(args.pretitle .. " " .. attacker .. " | " .. args.attack .. " | " .. target) end -- attack_capture --
function spellchant_capture(name, line, args) local caster = is_self(args.caster) test_print("FILTERED: " .. caster .. " cast " .. args.spell)
if players[caster] ~= nil then players[caster]:cast(args.spell) end
if is_looping(caster) then current_loop[caster]:cast(args.spell) end end -- spellchant_capture --
function nonfiltered_spellchant_capture(name, line, args) local caster = is_self(args.caster) test_print("NONFILTERED: " .. caster .. " cast " .. args.spell)
if players[caster] ~= nil then players[caster]:cast(args.spell) end
if is_looping(caster) then current_loop[caster]:cast(args.spell) end end -- nonfiltered_spellchant_capture --
function quaff_capture(name, line, args) local quaffer = is_self(args.quaffer) -- test_print(quaffer .. " quaffed " .. args.potion)
if players[quaffer] ~= nil then players[quaffer]:quaff(args.potion) end
if is_looping(quaffer) then current_loop[quaffer]:quaff(args.potion) end end -- quaff_capture --
function rescue_capture(name, line, args) local rescuer = is_self(args.rescuer) local rescuee = is_self(args.rescuee) test_print(rescuer .. " rescued " .. rescuee)
if players[rescuer] ~= nil then players[rescuer]:rescue(rescuee) end
if is_looping(rescuer) then current_loop[rescuer]:rescue(rescuee) end end -- rescue_capture --
function death_capture(name, line, args) if players[args.name] ~= nil then players[args.name]:die(args.mob) end test_print(args.name .. " died to " .. args.mob) end -- death_capture --
-------------------------- End Trigger Captures --------------------------
---------------------------- Group Management ----------------------------
function update_group() local members = gmcp("group.members") if members ~= "" then for i, member in ipairs(members) do local name = member.name local qs = tonumber(member.info.qs)
if players[name] == nil then players[name] = Player:new(name, qs) end
if looping and current_loop[name] == nil then current_loop[name] = Player:new(name, qs) end
if players[name].qs < 2 and qs == 2 then players[name]:quest() if looping then current_loop[name]:quest() end CallPlugin(commlog_id, "storeFromOutside", "ACTINFO: " .. name .. " finished quest at " .. os.date("%I:%M:%S")) end
players[name].qs = qs end end window_draw() end -- update_group --
function remove_member(name, line, args) if players[args.member] ~= nil then players[args.member] = nil end end -- remove_member --
function reset() players = {} update_group() print("Resetting activity tracker data") end -- reset --
function report() update_group() local sorted_players = table.i_copy(players) table.sort(sorted_players, function(p1, p2) return p1.total_attacks > p2.total_attacks end) for _, player in ipairs(sorted_players) do print(player:to_string()) end end -- report --
-------------------------- End Group Management ----------------------------
------------------------------- Genie --------------------------------------
function is_looping(player) return looping and current_loop[player] ~= nil end
-- [[ Start recording a new loop ]] -- function loop_new() if looping and not is_empty(current_loop) then table.insert(loops, current_loop) loop_report(current_loop) end looping = true current_loop = {} update_group() print("ACTI: Recording loop " .. #loops + 1) end -- loop_new --
-- [[ End the current loop without starting a new one ]] -- function loop_end() if looping and not is_empty(current_loop) then table.insert(loops, current_loop) loop_report(current_loop) end looping = false current_loop = {} print("ACTI: Ending current loop") end -- loop_end --
-- [[ Stop recording and delete the current loop ]] -- function loop_discard() looping = false print("ACTI: Discarding loop " .. #loops + 1) loop_end() end -- loop_discard --
-- [[ Stop recording and delete all loop data ]] -- function loop_reset() loops = {} current_loop = {} looping = false print("ACTI: Resetting loops") end -- loop_reset --
-- [[ Report each player's TOTAL loop performance ]] -- function loops_report() local loops_total = {}
if not is_empty(loops) then for _, loop in ipairs(loops) do for name, player in pairs(loop) do if loops_total[name] ~= nil then loops_total[name].total_attacks = loops_total[name].total_attacks + player.total_attacks local total_satks = loops_total[name].attacks["a blizzard of sand"] or 0 local loop_satks = player.attacks["a blizzard of sand"] or 0 loops_total[name].attacks["a blizzard of sand"] = total_satks + loop_satks loops_total[name].rescues = loops_total[name].rescues + player.rescues loops_total[name].deaths = loops_total[name].deaths + player.deaths else loops_total[name] = player end end end end
loop_report(loops_total) end -- loops_report --
-- [[ Report each player's performance for a loop ]] -- function loop_report(loop) local i_loop = table.i_copy(loop) table.sort(i_loop, function(p1, p2) local p1_satks = p1.attacks["a blizzard of sand"] or 0 local p2_satks = p2.attacks["a blizzard of sand"] or 0 return p1_satks > p2_satks end ) for _, player in ipairs(i_loop) do local satks = player.attacks["a blizzard of sand"] or 0 local output = player:to_string() output = string.gsub(output, "->", "-> Satk: " .. satks .. " |") print(output) end end -- loop_report --
------------------------- End Genie ------------------------
------------------------- Miniwindow ------------------------ data_option = 0
data_options = { [0] = "Attacks", [1] = "Healing", [2] = "Casts", [3] = "Rescues", [4] = "Quaffs", [5] = "Quests" }
data_options_length = 5
function next_data() data_option = data_option + 1 if data_option > data_options_length then data_option = 0 end update_group() end -- next_data --
function prev_data() data_option = data_option - 1 if data_option < 0 then data_option = data_options_length end update_group() end -- prev_data --
function window_init() DEFAULT_WIDTH = 300 DEFAULT_HEIGHT = 200 DEFAULT_X = 50 DEFAULT_Y = 700
MIN_SIZE = 50 LEFT_MARGIN = 10 TOP_MARGIN = 5
width = 0 height = 0
font_id = "font_" .. GetPluginID() font_name = "" font_size = ""
win = "win_" .. GetPluginID() windowinfo = ""
DEFAULT_BASE_COLOUR = ColourNameToRGB("white")
base_colour = GetVariable("base_colour") or DEFAULT_BASE_COLOUR end -- window_init --
window_init()
function window_send_front() CallPlugin("462b665ecb569efbf261422f","boostMe", win) end -- window_send_front --
function window_send_back() CallPlugin("462b665ecb569efbf261422f","dropMe", win) end -- window_send_back --
require "mw_theme_base" require "movewindow"
--[[ OnPluginInstall ]]-- function window_install() test_print("Setting window width and height from variable") width = tonumber(GetVariable("width")) if not exists(width) or width == 0 then width = DEFAULT_WIDTH end height = tonumber(GetVariable("height")) if not exists(height) or height == 0 then height = DEFAULT_HEIGHT end
test_print("Installing movewindow") windowinfo = movewindow.install( win, miniwin.pos_bottom_left, -- default_position miniwin.create_absolute_location, false, nil, {mouseup=MouseUp, mousedown=LeftClickOnly, dragmove=LeftClickOnly, dragrelease=LeftClickOnly}, {x=DEFAULT_X, y=DEFAULT_Y} )
test_print("Creating window") WindowCreate( win, windowinfo.window_left, windowinfo.window_top, width, height, windowinfo.window_mode, windowinfo.window_flags, Theme.PRIMARY_BODY )
test_print("win: " .. win) test_print("window_left: " .. windowinfo.window_left) test_print("window_top: " .. windowinfo.window_top) test_print("width: " .. width) test_print("height: " .. height)
-- Fonts local fonts = utils.getfontfamilies()
if not fonts.Dina then AddFont(GetInfo(66) .. "/Dina.fon") fonts = utils.getfontfamilites() end
if fonts["Dina"] then default_font_size = 8 default_font_name = "Dina" elseif fonts["Courier New"] then default_font_size = 9 default_font_name = "Courier New" else default_font_size = 9 default_font_name = "Lucida Console" end
font_name = GetVariable("font_name") or default_font_name font_size = tonumber(GetVariable("font_size")) or default_font_size WindowFont(win, font_id, font_name, font_size, false, false, false, false, 0)
-- Calculate font size metrics line_height = WindowFontInfo(win, font_id, 1) - WindowFontInfo(win, font_id, 4) + 2
resize_window() window_send_front() WindowShow(win, true) end -- window_install --
--[[ Draw the border and text ]]-- function window_draw() local left = LEFT_MARGIN local top = 0 local line = 1
-- Border bodyleft, bodytop, bodyright, bodybottom = Theme.DrawBorder(win) WindowRectOp(win, 2, bodyleft, bodytop, bodyright+1, bodybottom+1, Theme.PRIMARY_BODY) -- blank
function draw_text(text, colour) top = TOP_MARGIN + (line - 1) * line_height WindowText(win, font_id, text, left, top, bodyright, bodybottom, colour, false) line = line + 1 end -- draw_text --
local sorted_players = table.i_copy(players)
function sort_data() if data_option == 0 then table.sort(sorted_players, function(p1, p2) return p1.total_attacks > p2.total_attacks end) return function(player) return player.total_attacks end elseif data_option == 1 then table.sort(sorted_players, function(p1, p2) return p1.total_healing > p2.total_healing end) return function(player) return player.total_healing end elseif data_option == 2 then table.sort(sorted_players, function(p1, p2) return p1.total_casts > p2.total_casts end) return function(player) return player.total_casts end elseif data_option == 3 then table.sort(sorted_players, function(p1, p2) return p1.rescues > p2.rescues end) return function(player) return player.rescues end elseif data_option == 4 then table.sort(sorted_players, function(p1, p2) return p1.quaffs > p2.quaffs end) return function(player) return player.quaffs end elseif data_option == 5 then table.sort(sorted_players, function(p1, p2) return p1.quests > p2.quests end) return function(player) return player.quests end end end -- sort_data --
-- Title with hotspot arrows draw_text("<-" .. data_options[data_option] .. "->", base_colour) line = 2
local field = sort_data()
-- Write player data to window for _, player in ipairs(sorted_players) do draw_text(player.name .. " | " .. field(player), base_colour) end
Theme.AddResizeTag(win, 1, nil, nil, "MouseDown", "ResizeMoveCallback", "ResizeReleaseCallback")
CallPlugin("abc1a0944ae4af7586ce88dc", "BufferedRepaint") -- Resizes window immediately end -- window_draw --

function ResizeMoveCallback() if (startx == "") or (starty == "") then startx = WindowInfo(win, 17) starty = WindowInfo(win, 18) end
local posx = WindowInfo(win, 17) local posy = WindowInfo(win, 18)
width = width + posx - startx startx = posx
if width < MIN_SIZE then width = MIN_SIZE startx = windowinfo.window_left + width elseif windowinfo.window_left + width > GetInfo(281) then -- client window width width = GetInfo(281) - windowinfo.window_left startx = GetInfo(281) end
height = height + posy - starty starty = posy
if height < MIN_SIZE then height = MIN_SIZE starty = windowinfo.window_top + height elseif windowinfo.window_top + height > GetInfo(280) then -- client window height height = GetInfo(280) - windowinfo.window_top starty = GetInfo(280) end
if (utils.timer() - last_refresh > 0.033) then resize_window() last_refresh = utils.timer() end end -- ResizeMoveCallback --
